name: Solana Consumer App Workflow
goal: Build a consumer-facing application on Solana with embedded wallet onboarding, onchain interactions, and a smooth UX for users who have never held crypto.

alternative_tools.when_to_prefer: When the app only needs Solana and you want a simpler integration with email/social login embedded wallet creation. Privy has strong Solana embedded wallet support via @privy-io/react-auth with the Solana connector.
When building a non-browser app, server-side application, or autonomous agent on Solana. Turnkey provides server-side MPC key management without user-facing flows.

phases.phase_notes: Dynamic is the recommended choice for Solana consumer apps because it handles both embedded wallet creation (for new users) and external wallet connection (Phantom, Solflare, Backpack) in a single SDK. Solana's ecosystem has more existing wallet holders than EVM — a hybrid approach that welcomes both is correct. Use Dynamic's SolanaWalletConnectors for full coverage. If the app is Solana-only and targets brand-new-to-crypto users, Privy is simpler.

alternative_tools.when_to_prefer: When the app needs multi-chain RPC beyond Solana, or when the team is already on the QuickNode stack and wants a single provider relationship for all chains.

phases.phase_notes: Helius is the reference Solana RPC for consumer apps. It provides enhanced transaction parsing (human-readable Solana transactions), webhook support for wallet activity notifications, and DAS API for compressed NFTs and digital assets. Never use public Solana RPC in production — mainnet public endpoints are heavily rate-limited and unreliable. Helius free tier supports development and early MVP.

alternative_tools.when_to_prefer: When only token prices and market cap data are needed without Solana-specific portfolio or wallet analytics. CoinGecko has broader token coverage but no Solana-native portfolio features.

phases.phase_notes: Add this phase if the app displays token prices, portfolio values, or trending tokens. Birdeye provides real-time Solana token prices, DEX price feeds, portfolio snapshots, and token metadata. Required for any app with a 'your balance' or 'trending on Solana' UX component.

scale_overrides.hackathon: Skip unless price display is a core feature. Helius token balances are sufficient for wallet display without price data.

phases.phase_notes: On Solana, transaction landing reliability depends on priority fees. Without priority fees, consumer-facing transactions can silently fail during network congestion — a UX disaster. Jito bundles provide priority fee estimation and MEV protection. Add this phase when the app involves user-facing token transfers, swaps, or any high-stakes transaction where failure would degrade UX. Not required for read-only applications or apps with low transaction frequency.

scale_overrides.hackathon: Skip. Use default transaction settings. Priority fees are a production optimization.
scale_overrides.production: Required for any app with meaningful transaction volume. Silently dropped transactions at scale destroy user trust. Model priority fee cost per transaction before launch.

production_notes: Solana transaction confirmation is probabilistic — design the UX to handle 'pending' states gracefully. Do not assume transactions are confirmed until finalized.
Helius DAS API is the correct way to fetch NFT and compressed NFT data — do not rely on raw RPC calls for digital asset queries.
Dynamic's SolanaWalletConnectors must include all major Solana wallets (Phantom, Solflare, Backpack, Coinbase Wallet for Solana) to avoid alienating existing users.
Priority fees must be estimated dynamically, not hardcoded. Jito's fee estimation endpoint reflects current network conditions.
Account rent on Solana is a real cost — budget for account creation fees when users take first-time onchain actions.
tradeoffs: Dynamic's hybrid embedded + external wallet approach adds SDK complexity vs. a Privy-only embedded wallet. The tradeoff is worth it for Solana — existing Phantom users are a significant part of the audience.
Helius enhanced APIs are Solana-specific — they cannot be reused if the app ever expands to EVM chains. Multi-chain apps should consider QuickNode.
Priority fees improve reliability but add cost per transaction. At scale, priority fee economics must be modeled against user LTV.
Birdeye pricing is real-time but subject to rate limits — cache price data aggressively to avoid rate limit errors in high-traffic conditions.
anti_patterns: Using public Solana mainnet RPC in production — helius free tier is nearly free and prevents the dropped transactions and rate limit failures that plague public endpoints.
Requiring users to have Phantom installed — Solana consumer apps targeting new users must offer embedded wallet creation via Dynamic or Privy.
Hardcoding priority fees — Solana network congestion varies by orders of magnitude. Static fees either fail during congestion or overpay during quiet periods.
Fetching NFT data via raw RPC — use Helius DAS API instead. Raw RPC NFT queries are unreliable for compressed NFTs.
Not handling transaction expiry — Solana blockhashes expire after ~90 seconds. Consumer apps must implement retry logic with fresh blockhashes.

constraint_modifiers.modification: Dynamic's embedded wallet creation or Privy Solana embedded wallet covers the new-user case. Configure social login (email, Google, Twitter) as primary wallet creation flow.
Dynamic with SolanaWalletConnectors handles external wallet connection. Phantom, Solflare, and Backpack are the primary targets.
Add Vercel AI SDK as an ai-reasoning phase. For Solana data context, pass Helius transaction history or Birdeye portfolio data as context to the LLM.
Use Dynamic + Helius as the minimal stack. Skip market-data and transaction-priority phases unless core to the demo.

source.derived_from: corpus-expansion — CEO review gap analysis. Solana consumer app pattern validated against Solana ecosystem production apps.
